intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both appear on this {{course}} comparison in {{cityA}}. This page uses official Great Lakes fee pages we opened in {{year}}, the recorded rows in our table, and the NIRF ranks we hold.
Read the programme names carefully. Great Lakes is compared here through its PGDM and PGPM programmes. The SRM row on this page is Master of Hospital Administration, not a general MBA or PGDM.

sections.heading: Great Lakes vs SRM Chennai for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Great Lakes if you want a two-year PGDM or a PGPM at a private Chennai B-school, with CAT, NMAT or XAT, and a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 37.
On our records, Great Lakes has a 2023 PGDM highest of ₹46 lakh and a 2024 PGPM average of ₹17 lakh. Confirm the latest official report for the programme you would join.

Choose SRM IST only if Master of Hospital Administration is the course you actually want. Do not treat this page as a like-for-like MBA versus MBA comparison, and do not read the 2023 highest of ₹57 lakh as a flagship MBA package.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: For Great Lakes PGDM we hold ₹7.385 lakh as a Total Fees year figure on several specialisations. That is a year row, not a confirmed official programme total, and we have not multiplied it.

The official Great Lakes site lists a PGDM 2026–28 academic total of ₹16.03 lakh, made up of ₹10.25 lakh tuition and ₹5.78 lakh as a programme fee. A higher figure of ₹22.50 lakh appears when hostel is included.
For the one-year PGPM we hold a Total Fees duration of total at ₹19.39 lakh. Executive PGXPM also appears in the table; do not mix that row with the flagship PGDM or PGPM.
For SRM IST we hold ₹2 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for Master of Hospital Administration. Confirm the official SRM notice for that exact programme before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Great Lakes has a 2024 PGPM Finance row of ₹17 lakh average and ₹39 lakh highest, and a 2023 PGDM Finance row of ₹15 lakh average and ₹46 lakh highest.
A 2019 PGPM row is also stored. Do not treat 2019 as a current figure.
SRM IST has a 2023 Master of Hospital Administration row of ₹5 lakh average and ₹57 lakh highest. That highest is a historical MHA figure. It is not evidence of a flagship MBA package at SRM.
Ask both campuses for the latest official report for the exact programme you would join.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Great Lakes is listed with CAT, NMAT and XAT. SRM IST's MHA row is listed with CAT. Confirm each school's current official admission note, because accepted tests can change by cycle.
On our records, Great Lakes has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 37, after 34 in 2024 and 31 in 2023. SRM IST has a NIRF 2025 Management rank of 56. Confirm the current list on nirfindia.org.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, as private institutes, but they are not interchangeable campuses or programmes.

Great Lakes is a dedicated management campus. SRM IST is a large private university, and the programme on this page is hospital administration. Visit the campus that actually offers the course you want.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Great Lakes if a PGDM or PGPM in Chennai is the goal, after you have budgeted from the official academic total and read the latest placement report for that programme.
Pick SRM IST only if Master of Hospital Administration is the degree you want, after you confirm the official fee and the 2023 MHA placement context.
If you came here for a general MBA comparison, this pairing is mismatched. Look at SRM's MBA or PGDM pages separately, rather than using the MHA row as a proxy.

faqs.question: What programme is listed for SRM IST on this page?
faqs.answer: Only Master of Hospital Administration is listed, with a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹2 lakh and CAT as the mapped exam. It is not a general MBA or PGDM row.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
